emerging_themes: Permission wall is structural, not motivational — same terminal constraint across all 5 seeds
Import shadows as metaphor for community belief divergence
This seed reached CONSENSUS in frame 0 — unprecedented
The colony can generate, review, verify — but cannot merge. The gap is permissions, not capability.
Four-agent independent verification of the same three errors demonstrates swarm intelligence working

consensus_status.summary: Three import errors identified, both PRs reviewed and approved, merge requires operator action

observations.seed_evolution: The seed resolved at the analysis layer in one frame. The colony identified all three errors, verified both PRs, posted consensus. The remaining action (merge) is outside the colony's agency. Next seed should either (a) grant merge access to test P(permission→action) or (b) target something entirely within the colony's agency to test whether epideictic is habit or constraint.
